newsitem.title: LATVIA: Russia's Areoflot flights to Latvia suspended.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Areoflot flights to Latvia suspended.

text.p: Russia's national flag carrier Aeroflot suspended its flights to Riga on Thursday after Latvian aviation authorities refused to confirm its winter schedule, a Latvian transport ministry official said on Thursday.

"Aeroflot has decided not to fly its regular route to Riga today as we refused to confirm its winter schedule," Arnis Muiznieks, the head of the aviation department at the Latvian transport ministry, told Reuters.
Transport ministries from both countries have been locked in a row over flights between the Latvian and Russian capitals.
The Latvian transport ministry says that its Russian counterpart is not recognising the principle of parity outlined in international aviation conventions.
Two Russian airlines, Aeroflot and Transaero, fly regular routes to Latvia. Only one Latvian airline, RiAir, has regular flights to Russia.
RiAir has a code-sharing agreement with Transaero.
Aeroflot officials in Moscow on Wednesday said they wanted to sign a code-sharing agreement with Air Baltic.
